name: Amin Vahdat
summary: Amin Vahdat is named in 1 Part of The Buildout, most recently Part 13: The Ratepayer Pays First. Argued in Part 13 (The load pays its way).

mentions.excerpt: Amin Vahdat, who runs Google's AI infrastructure, told Sonya Huang on Sequoia's Training Data on October 6 that a utility building lines and plants for Google could in principle lift other customers' rates because of how billing works, so Google pays for the transmission lines, upgrades and added utility stations it requires.

sides.claim: Because of how billing works, a utility building out capacity for Google could in theory raise other people's rates, so Google ensures it pays for the transmission lines, upgrades and additional utility base stations required.
